jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.location: New York City · Hybrid · 3 days/week in office
jobs.why: Excellent healthcare implementation and operations fit: owns state expansions, payer launches, cross-functional project plans, trackers, handoffs and repeatable playbooks. Strong overlap with healthcare workflow design, onboarding, systems/process improvement and project ownership.
jobs.gap: The role favors consulting-style structured problem solving and startup scaling experience. Emphasize healthcare operations, workflow automation and 0-to-1 project ownership without overstating consulting background.

jobs.title: Clinical Operations Manager
jobs.location: New York · Hybrid preferred / Remote US
jobs.why: Outstanding behavioral-health operations match: daily clinical operations, workflow ownership, staff management, operational projects, SOPs and continuous improvement closely align with ABA healthcare operations, training and systems work.
jobs.gap: The salary only reaches the target at the top of the range, and the role asks for proven people management in a digital-health startup. Position training, recruiting, workflow ownership and healthcare operations leadership clearly.

jobs.title: Core Operations Manager
jobs.why: Excellent healthcare systems/process-improvement fit involving provider setup, claims and benefit systems, vendor performance, Jira/ServiceNow tracking, cross-functional requirements and operational improvement.
jobs.gap: MetroPlus asks for 5–7 years specifically in healthcare payer systems including claims, benefit configuration, provider data and migrations. This is a meaningful domain-depth gap, so emphasize intake/authorization workflows, systems troubleshooting, testing and process improvement without overstating payer experience.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Business Operations
jobs.location: New York City · Hybrid · typically Monday–Thursday in office
jobs.why: Very strong health-tech operations fit centered on market launches, SOPs, workflow redesign, AI-enabled automation, dashboards, operational metrics and cross-functional work with Product, Clinical, Growth and Finance.
jobs.gap: The role seeks 5+ years in business operations, strategy/operations or consulting and strong zero-to-one startup experience. Position cumulative operations/project experience and recent AI tool-building work clearly without inflating direct BizOps tenure.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare SaaS implementation role combining discovery, requirements, workflow configuration, project plans, training, documentation and cross-functional delivery with Product and Engineering.
jobs.gap: The role expects 5+ years of enterprise SaaS implementation plus stronger API, data-mapping and system-architecture fluency. Emphasize workflow implementation and systems ownership without overstating technical depth.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Project Manager
jobs.why: Strong healthcare implementation/project-management match: owns customer deployments, timelines, risks, go-live readiness, documentation, process improvement and coordination across Customer Success, Product, Engineering and Data Operations.
jobs.gap: The role strongly prefers 5–8+ years plus Workday/Oracle Cloud ERP migrations and Big 4-style implementation experience. Treat it as a stretch and emphasize implementation leadership, requirements, testing and systems coordination without claiming ERP migration depth.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager (Payments and Reconciliation)
jobs.location: New York, NY / Remote US hub cities
jobs.why: Healthcare operations role with strong process-improvement, automation, reporting, root-cause analysis and Product/Engineering partnership components. The systems-building aspect aligns well with workflow automation and operational problem solving.
jobs.gap: The core domain is financial reconciliation, claims banking and payment operations, and Maven asks for 6+ years in RCM/financial analysis/payment operations. This is a calculated stretch because financial-operations depth is the largest gap.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Business Operations
jobs.why: Strong systems-oriented business-operations role owning operating rhythms, cross-functional initiatives, KPI frameworks, dashboards and process execution in a technology company.
jobs.gap: This is outside healthcare and is a senior strategic BizOps role that likely favors deeper formal business-operations tenure and quantitative modeling experience. Lead with cross-functional operations, systems, dashboards and execution while keeping technical claims grounded.
